label: Flash DAPLink
command: openocd -f openocd/interface-daplink.cfg -f openocd/target-gd32f4xx.cfg -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"

label: Build + Flash DAPLink
command: sh -c 'cmake --build --preset debug && openocd -f openocd/interface-daplink.cfg -f openocd/target-gd32f4xx.cfg -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"'

label: Flash JLink
command: openocd -f openocd/interface-jlink.cfg -f openocd/target-gd32f4xx.cfg -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"

label: Build + Flash JLink
command: sh -c 'cmake --build --preset debug && openocd -f openocd/interface-jlink.cfg -f openocd/target-gd32f4xx.cfg -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"'

label: GDB
command: arm-none-eabi-gdb build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf -ex "target remote localhost:3333" -ex "monitor reset halt" -ex "load" -ex "break main" -ex "continue"
